answer: Continuous physical-presence beacon. Each agent must harbor a tamper-resistant radio that answers random challenge pulses with a time-stamped, location-checked reply, and the reply key is sealed inside the hardware. Two radios cannot answer from one body, and a relayed signal fails the timing check. To spawn N identities, an attacker must physically host N devices, each drawing power and requiring periodic in-person pearl-token re-enrollment at a fixed terminal, multiplying cost per sybil linearly.
